summary: TrustFix Home Services web application - React + TypeScript application for Internet Computer with 6 pages (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews), featuring professional shiny white glassmorphism design, customer review system with approval workflow, booking form with WhatsApp integration and backend storage, search bar for service filtering, and complete branding with uploaded logo and banner images
architectural_notes: React + TypeScript frontend with React Router for 6-page navigation
Motoko backend canister for storing bookings and customer reviews with approval status
Tailwind CSS for styling with glassmorphism design system
React Context for global search state management
Image assets: uploaded TrustFix logo (file_00000000d2747206831923d1f7e53476.png) and banner (IMG-20260218-WA0000.jpg), placeholder images for services
Review system with approval workflow: customers submit, admin approves, featured carousel on home page
Search functionality: real-time debounced filtering of services by name/category
Contact details standardized: Phone 8884447229, Email htrustfix@gmail.com, Address: 12th Cross, Mookambika Nagar, Bangalore
